title: Critical Minerals for a Just Transition
abstract: This article provides a critical review of the socioeconomic impacts of mining critical raw materials (CRMs), whose global demand is rising at an unprecedented pace due to the ongoing energy transition. Our review focuses on five key socioeconomic aspects: health, employment, human development, public services, and culture. These areas are significantly affected by mining in general, and by CRM extraction in particular, each with distinct features. By critically surveying the scientific literature on the spillovers of extractive industry, this review investigates and highlights the complexity of the interconnected impacts on the communities and regions that host mining projects. Thus, we call for a holistic, interdisciplinary approach to better understand these effects and their interactions. This perspective can help the international community pursue not only the energy transition, but also a just energy transition—one that internalizes the negative socioeconomic externalities and considers social justice, while mitigating environmental harms.
abstract_zh: 本文对开采关键原材料（CRMs）的社会经济影响进行了批判性综述。由于能源转型的持续推进，全球对这些原材料的需求正以前所未有的速度增长。本综述聚焦于五个关键的社会经济方面：健康、就业、人类发展、公共服务和文化。这些领域普遍受到采矿业的显著影响，而关键原材料的开采又各具特点。通过批判性地梳理有关采掘业溢出效应的学术文献，本综述考察并揭示了对承接矿业项目的社区和地区而言，各种影响之间错综复杂的相互关联。因此，我们呼吁采取整体性、跨学科的方法，以更好地理解这些影响及其相互作用。这一视角有助于国际社会不仅推进能源转型，还能实现公正的能源转型——即将负面的社会经济外部性内部化，兼顾社会公正，同时减轻环境危害。

title: Implications of Policy-Driven Transmission Expansion on Costs, Emissions, and Reliability in the United States
Using Machine Learning to Target Treatment: The Case of Household Energy Use
abstract: We use causal forests to evaluate the heterogeneous treatment effects (TEs) of repeated behavioral nudges towards household energy conservation. The average response is a monthly electricity reduction of 9 kilowatt-hours (kWh), but the full distribution of responses ranges from -30 to +10 kWh. Selective targeting of treatment using the forest raises social net benefits by 12-120 percent, depending on the year and welfare function. Pre-treatment consumption and home value are the strongest predictors of treatment effect. We find suggestive evidence of a "boomerang effect": households with lower consumption than similar neighbors are the ones with positive TE estimates.
abstract_zh: 我们运用因果森林方法，评估了针对家庭节能的重复性行为助推（nudges）所产生的异质性处理效应（TEs）。平均而言，助推使每月用电量减少9千瓦时（kWh），但全部响应的分布范围在-30至+10千瓦时之间。利用森林方法进行有选择的处理定向，可使社会净福利提高12%–120%，具体取决于年份和福利函数。处理前的消费量和住房价值是处理效应最强的预测因素。我们发现了“回旋镖效应”（boomerang effect）的初步证据：与相似邻居相比用电量较低的家庭，恰恰是处理效应估计值为正的家庭。

title: Who Bears the Burden of Climate Inaction?
abstract: Climate change is already increasing temperatures and raising the frequency of natural disasters in the United States. In this paper, we examine several major vectors through which climate change affects US households, including cost increases associated with home insurance claims and increased cooling, as well as sources of increased mortality. Although we consider only a subset of climate costs over recent decades, we find an aggregate annual cost averaging between $400 and $900 per household; in 10 percent of counties, costs exceed $1,300 per household. Costs vary significantly by geography, with the largest costs occurring in some western regions of the United States, the Gulf Coast, and Florida. Climate costs also typically disproportionately burden lower-income households. Our work suggests the importance of research that looks beyond rising temperatures to extreme weather events; so far, natural disasters account for the bulk of the burden of climate change in the United States. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 气候变化已经在推高美国的气温，并增加自然灾害的发生频率。本文考察了气候变化影响美国家庭的几条主要渠道，包括与房屋保险理赔相关的成本上升、制冷需求增加，以及死亡率上升。尽管我们只考虑了近几十年气候成本的一部分，但我们发现，年度总成本平均在每户400至900美元之间；在10%的县，成本超过每户1300美元。成本的地域差异十分显著，最高的成本出现在美国西部的一些地区、墨西哥湾沿岸和佛罗里达州。气候成本通常也对低收入家庭造成更不成比例的负担。我们的研究表明，研究不应只关注气温上升，还应关注极端天气事件；迄今为止，自然灾害占据了美国气候变化负担的绝大部分。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可以在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: On the Efficiency of Dynamic Electricity Prices
abstract: The marginal cost of electricity fluctuates hour-by-hour, yet retail customers typically face flat prices. Using data from all seven US wholesale markets and a new method to evaluate alternative rates set in advance that accounts for equilibrium price effects, we estimate efficiency gains from time-varying price schedules that better align price with cost. We have three main results. First, time-of-use rates and critical-peak pricing, the two most common time-varying rate plans, each correct about 10% of mispricing. Second, complex rate structures based on historical prices often backfire. Third, real-time pricing with price ceilings can capture most potential efficiency gains while limiting customer risk. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 电力的边际成本逐时波动，但零售用户通常面临的是平价电价。利用美国全部七个批发市场的数据，并采用一种新方法来评估预先设定的替代费率——该方法考虑了均衡价格效应——我们估计了使价格更好地反映成本的分时电价方案所带来的效率收益。我们有三项主要结果。第一，分时电价和高峰定价这两种最常见的时变费率方案，各自纠正了约10%的价格扭曲。第二，基于历史价格的复杂费率结构往往适得其反。第三，设有价格上限的实时定价，可以获得大部分潜在的效率收益，同时限制用户面临的风险。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户，以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Flexible Data Centers and the Grid: Lower Costs, Higher Emissions?
abstract: Data centers are among the fastest-growing electricity consumers, raising concerns about their impact on grid operations and decarbonization goals. Their temporal flexibility-the ability to shift workloads over time-offers a source of demand-side flexibility. We model power systems in three U.S. regions: Mid-Atlantic, Texas, and WECC, under varying flexibility levels. We evaluate flexibility's effects on grid operations, investment, system costs, and emissions. Across all scenarios, flexible data centers reduce costs by shifting load from peak to off-peak hours, flattening net demand, and supporting renewable and baseload resources. This load shifting facilitates renewable integration while improving the utilization of existing baseload capacity. As a result, the emissions impact depends on which effect dominates. Higher renewable penetration increases the emissions-reduction potential of data center flexibility, while lower shares favor baseload generation and may raise emissions. Our findings highlight the importance of aligning data center flexibility with renewable deployment and regional conditions.
abstract_zh: 数据中心是增长最快的用电主体之一，其对电网运行和脱碳目标的影响引发了关注。数据中心的时间灵活性，即在时间上转移工作负载的能力，提供了一种需求侧灵活性。我们对美国三个区域——大西洋中部地区、得克萨斯州和WECC（西部电力协调委员会）——的电力系统进行了建模，并考虑了不同的灵活性水平。我们评估了灵活性对电网运行、投资、系统成本和排放的影响。在所有情景下，灵活的数据中心通过将负荷从高峰时段转移至非高峰时段、平抑净需求并支持可再生能源和基荷电源，从而降低了成本。这种负荷转移有助于可再生能源的并网，同时提高了现有基荷发电容量的利用率。因此，排放影响取决于哪种效应占主导。可再生能源渗透率越高，数据中心灵活性的减排潜力越大；而可再生能源占比较低时，则有利于基荷发电，并可能增加排放。我们的研究结果强调，数据中心的灵活性应与可再生能源部署和区域条件相互匹配。

title: From Tank to Odometer: Winners and Losers from a Gas-to-VMT Tax Shift
Planes Overhead: How Airplane Noise Impacts Home Values
Pollution, Population, and Production: A Structural Analysis of Wildfire Smoke and Spatial Sorting
Assessing the distribution of employment vulnerability to the energy transition using employment carbon footprints
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: As the world moves away from fossil fuels, there is growing recognition of the need for a just transition of those working in carbon-intensive industries and for policy to support this transition. While recent policies such as the U.S. Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) have begun to incorporate support for energy-intensive regions, little work has thoroughly investigated which communities are most vulnerable to economic disruption in the energy transition and therefore require policy support. This paper analyzes the distribution of employment vulnerability in the U.S. by calculating the average “employment carbon footprint” of close-to every job in the U.S. economy at high geographic and sectoral granularity. The measure considers employment vulnerability across the entire economy and captures both fossil fuel consumption and production effects, with the sectors covered in our analysis accounting for 86% of total U.S. employment and 94% of U.S. carbon emissions outside of the transportation sector. We find that existing efforts to identify at-risk communities both in the literature and the IRA exclude regions of high employment vulnerability, and thereby risk leaving these communities behind in the energy transition. This work underscores the importance of proactive and continuous measures of employment vulnerability, presents policymakers with much-needed data to incorporate such measures into just transition policy and makes the case for place-based policy approaches when considering how best to support communities through the energy transition.
abstract_zh: 随着世界逐步摆脱化石燃料，人们日益认识到，有必要为从事高碳产业的劳动者提供公正转型，并需要政策予以支持。尽管《通胀削减法案》（IRA）等近期政策已开始纳入对能源密集型地区的支持，但很少有研究深入探讨哪些社区最易在能源转型中遭受经济冲击，从而最需要政策支持。本文通过以高度的地理和行业细化程度，计算美国经济中几乎每一个工作岗位的平均“就业碳足迹”，分析了美国就业脆弱性的分布。该指标考虑了整个经济范围内的就业脆弱性，并同时捕捉化石燃料消费和生产两方面的效应；本文所涵盖的行业占美国总就业的86%，占美国交通运输部门以外碳排放的94%。我们发现，文献和《通胀削减法案》中现有的识别高风险社区的努力，都排除了就业脆弱性较高的地区，从而有可能使这些社区在能源转型中被落下。这项工作强调了持续、主动地衡量就业脆弱性的重要性，为政策制定者提供了亟需的数据，以将此类测度纳入公正转型政策，并论证了在考虑如何帮助社区度过能源转型时，采用因地制宜政策方法的必要性。

title: Can Federal Grid Reforms Solve the Interconnection Problem?
US Federal Resource Allocations are Inconsistent with Concentrations of Energy Poverty
abstract: Recent data from the US Energy Information Administration reveals that nearly one in three households in the United States report experiencing energy poverty, and this number is only expected to rise. Federal assistance programs exist, but allocations across states have been nearly static since 1984, while the distribution of energy poverty is dynamic in location and time. We implement a LASSO-based machine learning approach using sociodemographic and geographical information to estimate energy burden in each US census tract for 2015 and 2020. We then compare the allocation to states from the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program to an optimized allocation. We allocate funds to the most burdened households, providing them with enough assistance to reduce their energy expenditures so that their household energy burden is equal to a new maximum allowable energy burden. This markedly shifts funds from the northern cold-weather states to the southern warm-weather states.
abstract_zh: 美国能源信息署的最新数据显示，美国近三分之一的家庭表示经历过能源贫困，而且这一数字预计还将继续上升。联邦援助项目已经存在，但自1984年以来，各州的拨款分配几乎一成不变，而能源贫困的分布在地点和时间上却是动态变化的。我们采用基于LASSO的机器学习方法，利用社会人口和地理信息，估算了2015年和2020年美国每个人口普查区的能源负担。随后，我们将低收入家庭取暖能源援助计划（LIHEAP）向各州的拨款分配，与一种优化分配方案进行了比较。我们将资金分配给负担最重的家庭，为其提供足够的援助以降低能源支出，使其家庭能源负担等于一个新设定的最高可承受能源负担水平。这一做法显著地将资金从北方寒冷气候州转向南方温暖气候州。

title: Small Changes, Big Impact: Nudging Employees Toward Sustainable Behaviors
abstract: We designed and conducted three randomized control trials in partnership with a large biopharmaceutical company operating over 160 plasma donation centers, with the aim of promoting sustainable behaviors in a workplace setting. Specifically, we focused on reducing operational errors that led to dropped collection materials, long freezer door open times, and improper recycling practices. To achieve these goals, we employed social norms to nudge employees towards 1) reducing wasted collection materials, 2) minimizing the duration of freezer door openings, and 3) improving recycling practices. We found an average reduction of roughly 70 percent in plastic waste from dropped collection materials and the costs associated with these materials. The frequency of freezer door alarms decreased by over 80 percent, and the duration of alarms decreased by over 45 percent, depending on the empirical specification. We also observed a roughly 40 percent reduction in uncollapsed cardboard, with no statistically significant results for other types of contaminants. Importantly, for each of the interventions, we do not find evidence that the treatment effects waned over time or affected business operations. Our study provides significant implications for promoting sustainable behaviors in a workplace setting, filling an important gap in the literature on the effectiveness of nudges in the workplace.
abstract_zh: 我们与一家在160多个血浆采集中心运营的大型生物制药公司合作，设计并开展了三项随机对照试验，旨在促进工作场所中的可持续行为。具体而言，我们着眼于减少导致采集材料掉落、冷冻柜门开启时间过长以及回收操作不当的运营失误。为实现这些目标，我们运用社会规范来引导员工：1）减少浪费的采集材料，2）缩短冷冻柜门开启的时长，3）改善回收做法。我们发现，掉落采集材料所造成的塑料废弃物及相关成本平均减少了约70%。冷冻柜门报警的频率下降了80%以上，报警持续时间下降了45%以上（取决于具体的实证设定）。我们还观察到未压扁纸板减少了约40%，而其他类型污染物则无统计显著的结果。重要的是，对于每一项干预措施，我们均未发现处理效应随时间衰减，或对业务运营产生影响的证据。本研究为促进工作场所的可持续行为提供了重要启示，填补了关于助推在工作场所有效性研究的重要空白。

title: Two Wrongs Can Sometimes Make a Right: The Environmental Benefits of Market Power in Oil
abstract: Market power reduces equilibrium quantities and distorts production, typically causing welfare losses. However, as Buchanan (1969) noted, market power may mitigate overproduction from negative externalities. This paper examines this in the global oil market, where OPEC's market power affects oil production and carbon intensity. We estimate that from 1970 to 2021, OPEC's market power reduced emissions by over 67 GtCO2, equating to $4,073 billion in climate damages and 17.8% of the carbon budget needed for the 1.5 C Paris Agreement target. This environmental benefit outweighs the welfare loss from distorted production allocation.
abstract_zh: 市场势力会降低均衡产量并扭曲生产，通常造成福利损失。然而，正如Buchanan（1969）所指出的，市场势力可能会缓解负外部性所导致的过度生产。本文在全球石油市场中考察了这一问题，其中欧佩克的市场势力影响石油产量和碳强度。我们估计，1970年至2021年间，欧佩克的市场势力减少了超过670亿吨二氧化碳（GtCO2）的排放，相当于4.073万亿美元的气候损害，并占实现《巴黎协定》1.5摄氏度目标所需碳预算的17.8%。这种环境效益超过了生产配置扭曲所带来的福利损失。

title: Using Information to Curb Racial Discrimination
Designing Climate Policy Mixes: Analytical and Energy System Modeling Approaches
abstract: A matter of debate in climate policy is whether lawmakers should rely on carbon pricing or regulations, such as low-carbon standards, to reach emission reduction goals. Past research showed that pricing is more cost-effective. However, previous work studied the two policies when implemented separately, in effect comparing two policy extremes. In contrast, we explore the full spectrum of climate policy mixes that include both types of policies but vary in how much they rely on each. We do this both analytically by extending previous theory and numerically with two energy system models. In line with past work, increasing reliance on pricing increases the cost-effectiveness of the policy mix. However, we show that this benefit exhibits diminishing marginal returns. Thus the gain in cost-effectiveness from complementing stringent standards with modest pricing is relatively large. Our results show that relying on pricing for 20% of emission reductions (and on a standard for 80%) reduces costs by 32%–57% compared to a standard-only approach. Importantly, trading off more of the standard for pricing delivers smaller and smaller gains in cost-effectiveness. For example, a policy mix that relies on each policy for 50% of emission reductions decreases costs by 60%–81%, which is already 71%–88% as cost-effective as the theoretically most cost-effective pricing-only policy.
abstract_zh: 气候政策领域的一个争论焦点是：立法者应依靠碳定价还是依靠低碳标准等监管措施来实现减排目标。以往研究表明，定价的成本效益更高。然而，既有研究往往分别考察两类政策的单独实施，实际上比较的是两种政策极端。与之相对，我们考察了包含两类政策、但对二者依赖程度各不相同的全部气候政策组合。我们既通过扩展既有理论进行了解析分析，也借助两个能源系统模型进行了数值分析。与以往研究一致，增加对定价的依赖会提高政策组合的成本效益。然而，我们表明，这种收益呈现边际递减的特征。因此，以适度定价补充严格标准所带来的成本效益提升相对较大。我们的结果显示，以定价承担20%的减排量（标准承担80%），与纯标准方案相比，可降低32%–57%的成本。重要的是，用定价替代越来越多的标准，所带来的成本效益增益越来越小。例如，两类政策各承担50%减排量的政策组合，可使成本降低60%–81%，这已达到理论上成本效益最高的纯定价政策的71%–88%。

title: Policies for Electrifying the Light-Duty Vehicle Fleet in the United States
abstract: Decarbonization of light-duty vehicles (LDVs) in the United States is an important policy priority. We investigate the roles of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act and the Inflation Reduction Act in accelerating the transition of LDVs to electric vehicles. We additionally consider alternate allocations of government funds for subsidized construction of charging stations and refundable tax credits for electric vehicles. We find that charging station subsidies are extremely effective as measured by impact for a given fiscal expenditure. All of the policies we consider have estimated costs below the most recent estimate of the social cost of carbon.
abstract_zh: 美国轻型汽车（LDVs）的脱碳是一项重要的政策优先事项。我们考察了《基础设施投资和就业法案》与《通胀削减法案》在加速轻型汽车向电动汽车转型方面的作用。我们还考虑了政府资金的其他分配方式，包括对充电站建设的补贴以及对电动汽车的可退还税收抵免。我们发现，以单位财政支出所产生的影响来衡量，充电站补贴的效果极为显著。我们所考虑的所有政策，其估计成本均低于社会碳成本的最新估计值。

title: An Economic Analysis of the Self-Preferencing Debate
Exporting Global Warming? Coal Trade and the Shale Gas Boom
abstract:
We examine the effect of the US shale gas boom on the international trade and consumption of coal and emissions. We estimate a structural model that links the domestic to the international coal market and use it to simulate counterfactual scenarios. Our results show that the total quantity of coal traded around the world in the absence of the boom is essentially the same as the actual. Moreover, the change in total coal consumed worldwide is also small. Although a compositional change towards coal with different heat content could have significant environmental effects, we show that this is not the case either. Hence, US coal exports simply displaced other coal exports without affecting the total CO and SO
emissions. Despite the small overall effects, several countries experience a substantial decrease in their imports of US coal and the associated emissions in the absence of the boom.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了美国页岩气繁荣对煤炭国际贸易、消费及排放的影响。我们估计了一个结构模型，该模型将国内煤炭市场与国际煤炭市场联系起来，并利用其模拟反事实情景。结果表明，若不存在这一繁荣，全球煤炭的贸易总量与实际情况基本相同。此外，全球煤炭消费总量的变化也很小。尽管不同热值煤炭的结构性变化可能产生显著的环境影响，但我们表明，情况并非如此。因此，美国煤炭出口只是取代了其他煤炭出口，而并未影响CO和SO₂的排放总量。尽管总体影响较小，但若不存在这一繁荣，一些国家从美国进口煤炭及相应的排放会大幅下降。

title: The Intersection of Self-Preferencing and Pricing Practices in the Digital World

title: The Role of Output Reallocation and Investment in Coordinating Externality Markets
Subsidizing Fuel Efficient Cars: Evidence from China's Automobile Industry
Attribute Substitution in Household Vehicle Portfolios
Estimating the Costs and Benefits of Fuel-Economy Standards
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: Fuel-economy standards for new vehicles are a primary policy instrument in many countries to reduce the carbon footprint of the transportation sector. These standards have many channels of costs and benefit, impacting sales, composition, vehicle attributes, miles traveled and externalities in the new-car fleet, as well as the composition and size of the used fleet. We develop a tractable analytical framework to examine the welfare effects of fuel-economy standards, and apply it to the recent government proposal to roll back fuel-economy standards. We find that our combined, multi-market vehicle choice model implies that the proposal would increase the size of the vehicle fleet over time, and also generates smaller welfare gains than models with a less rich structure of the vehicle market, such as the one used in the analysis associated with the 2018 Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM) announcement. The disparities across the two models appear to result from the absence of feedback effects in the NPRM analysis. We stress the importance of instead using a multi-market vehicle choice model to provide the most accurate predictions of costs and benefits. We also derive bounds that can serve as a check on the theoretical consistency of such analyses, and that offer insights into the magnitudes of potential errors resulting from imperfect multi-market integration.
abstract_zh: 新车燃油经济性标准是许多国家降低交通运输部门碳足迹的主要政策工具。这些标准通过多种渠道产生成本和收益，影响销量、车型结构、车辆属性、行驶里程以及新车队的外部性，并影响二手车队的构成与规模。我们构建了一个易于处理的解析框架，考察燃油经济性标准的福利效应，并将其应用于政府近期提出的放松燃油经济性标准的方案。我们发现，我们结合多个市场的车辆选择模型表明，该方案将随时间推移扩大车队规模，而且所带来的福利收益也小于那些车辆市场结构较简单的模型，例如2018年《拟议规则制定通知》（NPRM）所采用的模型。两种模型之间的差异似乎源于NPRM分析中缺乏反馈效应。我们强调，应当改用多市场车辆选择模型，以对成本和收益作出最为准确的预测。我们还推导了一些界限，可用于检验此类分析的理论一致性，并揭示由多市场整合不完善所可能导致的误差大小。

title: Machine Learning from Schools about Energy Efficiency
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We use high-frequency panel data on electricity consumption to study the effectiveness of energy efficiency upgrades in K–12 schools in California. Using a panel fixed effects approach, we find that these upgrades deliver between 12% and 86% of expected savings, depending on specification and treatment of outliers. Using machine learning to inform our specification choice, we estimate a narrower range: 52%–98%, with a central estimate of 60%. These results imply that upgrades are performing less well than ex ante predictions on average, although we can reject some of the very low realization rates found in prior work.
abstract_zh: 我们利用高频面板电力消费数据，研究加州K–12年级学校节能改造的成效。采用面板固定效应方法，我们发现这些改造所带来的节能量为预期节约量的12%至86%，具体取决于模型设定以及对异常值的处理方式。借助机器学习来辅助确定模型设定，我们将估计范围缩小至52%–98%，中心估计值为60%。这些结果表明，改造的实际效果平均而言低于事前预测，不过我们可以排除先前研究中发现的一些极低的实现率。

title: Racial and Gender Discrimination in Transportation Network Companies
Sufficient Statistics for Imperfect Externality-Correcting Policies
The Efficiency and Distributional Effects of Alternative Residential Electricity Rate Designs
abstract: Electricity tariffs typically charge residential users a volumetric rate that covers the bulk of energy, transmission, and distribution costs. The resulting prices, charged per unit of electricity consumed, do not reflect marginal costs and vary little across time and space. The emergence of distributed energy resources-such as solar photovoltaics and energy storage-has sparked interest among regulators and utilities in reforming electricity tariffs to enable more efficient utilization of these resources. The economic pressure to redesign electricity rates is countered by concerns of how more efficient rate structures might impact different socioeconomic groups. We analyze the bill impacts of alternative rate plans using interval metering data for more than 100,000 customers in the Chicago, Illinois area. We combine these data with granular Census data to assess the incidence of bill changes across different socioeconomic groups. We find that low-income customers would face bill increases on average in a transition to more economically efficient electricity tariffs. However, we demonstrate that simple changes to fixed charges in twopart tariffs can mitigate these disparities while preserving all, or the vast majority, of the efficiency gains. These designs rely exclusively on observable information and could be replicated by utilities in many geographies across the U.S.
abstract_zh: 电力资费通常对居民用户采用按量计价的费率，该费率涵盖了大部分能源、输电和配电成本。这种按消耗电量计价的价格，并不能反映边际成本，而且在时间和空间上几乎没有变化。分布式能源资源（如太阳能光伏和储能）的兴起，促使监管机构和公用事业公司对电价改革产生兴趣，以便更高效地利用这些资源。然而，改革电价的经济压力，又受到以下担忧的制约：更高效的费率结构可能对不同社会经济群体产生何种影响。我们利用伊利诺伊州芝加哥地区超过10万名用户的分段计量数据，分析了替代费率方案对账单的影响。我们将这些数据与细粒度的人口普查数据相结合，以评估不同社会经济群体所面临的账单变化分布。我们发现，在向经济效率更高的电价过渡时，低收入用户平均而言将面临账单上涨。然而，我们证明，对两部制电价中的固定费用进行简单调整，即可在保留全部或绝大部分效率收益的同时，缓解这些差距。这些设计完全依赖可观测信息，美国许多地区的公用事业公司均可复制。

title: The Short-Run and Long-Run Effects of Covid-19 on Energy and the Environment
Are Consumers Poorly Informed About Fuel Economy? Evidence from Two Experiments
abstract: It is often asserted that consumers are poorly informed about and inattentive to fuel economy, causing them to buy low-fuel economy vehicles despite their own best interest. This paper presents evidence on this assertion through two experiments providing fuel economy information to new vehicle shoppers. Results show zero statistical or economic effect on average fuel economy of vehicles purchased. In the context of a simple optimal policy model, the estimates suggest that current and proposed US fuel economy standards are significantly more stringent than needed to address the classes of imperfect information and inattention addressed by our interventions. (JEL C93, D12, D83, D91, L62, Q48)
abstract_zh: 人们常常断言，消费者对燃油经济性缺乏了解，也不够关注，因而即便违背自身利益，仍会购买燃油经济性较差的车辆。本文通过向新车购买者提供燃油经济性信息的两项实验，对这一论断提供了证据。结果显示，对所购车辆的平均燃油经济性，在统计上和经济上均无任何影响。在一个简单的最优政策模型框架下，估计结果表明，美国现行及拟议中的燃油经济性标准，远比解决我们的干预所针对的信息不完全和注意力不足问题所需的标准更为严格。（JEL分类：C93, D12, D83, D91, L62, Q48）

title: Are Fuel Economy Standards Regressive?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Despite widespread agreement that a carbon tax would be more efficient, many countries use fuel economy standards to reduce transportation-related carbon dioxide emissions. We pair a simple model of the automakers' profit maximization problem with unusually-rich nationally representative data on vehicle registrations to estimate the distributional impact of U.S. fuel economy standards. The key insight from the model is that fuel economy standards impose a constraint on automakers which creates an implicit subsidy for fuel-efficient vehicles and an implicit tax for fuel-inefficient vehicles. Moreover, when these obligations are tradable, permit prices make it possible to quantify the exact magnitude of these implicit subsidies and taxes. We use the model to determine which U.S. vehicles are most subsidized and taxed, and we compare the pattern of ownership of these vehicles between high-and low-income census tracts. Finally, we compare these distributional impacts with existing estimates in the literature on the distributional impact of a carbon tax.
abstract_zh: 尽管人们普遍认为碳税效率更高，许多国家仍采用燃油经济性标准来减少交通运输相关的二氧化碳排放。我们将汽车制造商利润最大化问题的一个简单模型，与异常丰富的、具有全国代表性的车辆登记数据相结合，以估计美国燃油经济性标准的分配效应。该模型的关键见解在于，燃油经济性标准对汽车制造商施加了一种约束，从而为高燃油效率车辆创造了隐含补贴，并为低燃油效率车辆形成了隐含税负。此外，当这些义务可交易时，许可证价格使我们能够精确量化这些隐含补贴和税负的大小。我们运用该模型确定哪些美国车辆获得的补贴最多、承担的税负最重，并比较了高收入与低收入人口普查区对这些车辆的持有格局。最后，我们将这些分配效应与文献中已有的关于碳税分配效应的估计结果进行了比较。

title: Environmental Implications of Market Structure: Shale Gas and Electricity
How do Carbon Emissions Respond to Business-Cycle Shocks?
The Local Economic and Welfare Consequences of Hydraulic Fracturing
Flawed analyses of U.S. auto fuel economy standards
The Welfare Impact of Indirect Pigouvian Taxation: Evidence from Transportation
abstract: A basic tenet of economics posits that when consumers or firms don't face the true social cost of their actions, market outcomes are inefficient. In the case of negative externalities, Pigouvian taxes are one way to correct this market failure, where the optimal tax leads agents to internalize the true cost of their actions.A practical complication, however, is that the level of externality nearly always varies across economic agents and directly taxing the externality may be infeasible. In such cases, policy often taxes a product correlated with the externality. For example, instead of taxing vehicle emissions directly, policy makers may tax gasoline even though per-gallon emissions vary across vehicles. This paper estimates the implications of this approach within the personal transportation market. We have three general empirical results. First, we show that vehicle emissions are positively correlated with vehicle elasticities for miles traveled with respect to fuel prices (in absolute value)-i.e.dirtier vehicles respond more to fuel prices. This correlation substantially increases the optimal second-best uniform gasoline tax. Second, and perhaps more importantly, we show that a uniform tax performs very poorly in eliminating deadweight loss associated with vehicle emissions; in many years in our sample over 75 percent of the deadweight loss remains under the optimal second-best gasoline tax. Substantial improvements to market efficiency require differentiating based on vehicle type, for example vintage. Finally, there is a more positive result: because of the positive correlation between emissions and elasticities, the health benefits from a given gasoline tax increase by roughly 90 percent, compared to what one would expect if emissions and elasticities were uncorrelated.
abstract_zh: 经济学的一条基本原理认为，当消费者或企业并未面对其行为的真实社会成本时，市场结果便是低效的。在存在负外部性的情况下，庇古税是纠正这一市场失灵的方法之一，最优税率可促使经济主体将其行为的真实成本内部化。然而，一个实际的复杂问题在于，外部性水平几乎总是因经济主体而异，而直接对外部性征税可能并不可行。在这种情况下，政策往往对与外部性相关的产品征税。例如，政策制定者可能不直接对车辆排放征税，而是对汽油征税，尽管每加仑汽油的排放量因车型而异。本文在个人交通运输市场中估计了这一做法的影响。我们得出三个总体实证结论。第一，我们表明，车辆排放与车辆对燃油价格的里程需求弹性（取绝对值）呈正相关，即排放较高的车辆对燃油价格的反应更为敏感。这种相关性显著提高了最优次优统一汽油税。第二，也许更为重要的是，我们表明，统一税在消除与车辆排放相关的无谓损失方面表现很差；在样本中的许多年份，即使采用最优次优汽油税，仍有超过75%的无谓损失存在。实质性地提高市场效率，需要根据车型类别（例如车辆的生产年份）进行差别化征税。最后，还有一个较为积极的结论：由于排放与弹性之间存在正相关，给定汽油税所带来的健康效益，比二者不相关时的预期高出约90%。

title: Keeping it Fresh: Strategic Product Redesigns and Welfare
Strategic Policy Choice in State-Level Regulation: The EPA's Clean Power Plan
The Pass-Through of RIN Prices to Wholesale and Retail Fuels under the Renewable Fuel Standard
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: The U.S. Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) requires blending increasing quantities of biofuels into the U.S. surface vehicle fuel supply. In 2013, the fraction of ethanol in the gasoline pool effectively reached 10%, the ethanol capacity of the dominant U.S. gasoline blend (the “E10 blend wall”). During 2013-2015, the price of RINs—tradeable electronic certificates for complying with the RFS—fluctuated through a wide range, largely because of changes in actual and expected policy combined with learning about the implications of the E10 blend wall. RINs are sold by biofuels producers and purchased by obligated parties (refiners and importers), who must retire RINs in proportion to the petroleum they sell for surface transportation. As a result, RINs in effect serve as a charge on obligated fuels and a corrective subsidy for lower-carbon renewable fuels, and are neutral for fuels outside the RFS. In theory, RIN prices provide incentives to consumers to use fuels with a high renewable content and to biofuels producers to produce those fuels, and as such are a key mechanism of the RFS. This paper examines the extent to which RIN prices are passed through to the price of obligated fuels, and provides econometric results that complement the graphical analysis in Burkholder (2015). We analyze daily data on RINs and fuel prices from January 1, 2013 through March 10, 2015. When we examine wholesale prices on comparable obligated and non-obligated fuels, for example the spread between diesel and jet fuel in the U.S. Gulf, we find that that roughly one-half to three-fourths of a change in RIN prices is passed through to obligated fuels in the same day as the RIN price movement, and this fraction rises over the subsequent few business days. Using six different wholesale spreads between obligated and non-obligated fuels, we estimate a pooled long-run pass-through coefficient of 1.01 with a standard error of 0.12. We also examine the transmission of RIN prices to retail fuel prices. The net RIN obligation on E10 is essentially zero over this period, and indeed we find no statistical evidence linking changes in RIN prices to changes in E10 prices. We also examine the price of E85 which, with an estimated average of 74% ethanol, generates more RINs than it obligates and thus in principle receives a large RIN subsidy. In contrast to the foregoing results, which are consistent with theory, the pass-through of RIN prices to the E85-E10 spread is precisely estimated to be zero if one adjusts for seasonality (as we argue should be done), or if not, is at most 30%. Over this period, on average high RIN prices did not translate into discounted prices for E85.
abstract_zh: 美国《可再生燃料标准》（RFS）要求在美国地面车辆燃料供应中掺入日益增多的生物燃料。2013年，汽油池中的乙醇比例实际上已达到10%，即主流美国汽油配方的乙醇容纳上限（“E10掺混墙”）。2013至2015年间，RIN的价格——即用于履行RFS义务的可交易电子凭证——在很大范围内波动，这主要是由于实际政策与预期政策的变化，以及对E10掺混墙影响的认识不断深化。RIN由生物燃料生产商出售，由负有义务的主体（炼油商和进口商）购买，后者必须按其为地面交通运输出售的石油量比例注销RIN。因此，RIN实际上构成了对有义务燃料的一种征费，同时也是对低碳可再生燃料的一种矫正性补贴，而对RFS范围之外的燃料则不产生影响。从理论上讲，RIN价格既激励消费者使用可再生成分高的燃料，也激励生物燃料生产商生产此类燃料，因而是RFS的关键机制。本文考察了RIN价格向有义务燃料价格的传导程度，并提供了补充Burkholder（2015）图形分析的计量结果。我们分析了2013年1月1日至2015年3月10日期间RIN和燃料价格的日度数据。当我们考察可比的有义务燃料与无义务燃料的批发价格，例如美国墨西哥湾地区柴油与航空煤油之间的价差时，我们发现，RIN价格变动的大约一半至四分之三会在RIN价格变动的当日传导至有义务燃料，并且这一比例在随后几个工作日内会上升。使用六种不同的有义务燃料与无义务燃料之间的批发价差，我们估计出一个合并的长期传导系数为1.01，标准误为0.12。我们还考察了RIN价格向零售燃料价格的传导。在此期间，E10的净RIN义务基本为零，而我们也确实未发现RIN价格变动与E10价格变动之间存在统计上显著的关联。我们还考察了E85的价格，其平均乙醇含量估计为74%，因而产生的RIN数量超过其义务数量，原则上应获得较大的RIN补贴。与上述符合理论预期的结果相反，若进行季节性调整（正如我们认为应当进行的），RIN价格向E85–E10价差的传导被精确地估计为零；若不进行调整，其传导比例至多为30%。在此期间，RIN价格高企平均而言并未转化为E85的折扣价格。

title: Are we fracked? The impact of falling gas prices and the implications for coal-to-gas switching and carbon emissions
abstract: We discuss the environmental implications of the dramatic drop in the price of natural gas following the US shale gas boom due to the rise of modern hydraulic fracturing. In the first part of the paper, we argue that the ensuing drop in the price of natural gas has an ambiguous effect on global carbon emissions because of three countervailing effects: coal-to-gas switching in the US electric power sector, an increase in the relative cost of US renewable energy sources, and an increase in US coal exports. Our position is that without a meaningful cap, the shale gas boom is likely to increase global emissions and the period during which natural gas is used as a bridge fuel to clean energy should be limited. In the second part of the paper, we review recent environmental policies for the US electric power sector that have contributed to reducing carbon emissions, and discuss the complex economics of the newly introduced Clean Power Plan. Although the availability of cheap natural gas has been factored in US environmental policy and has helped electricity generators to achieve compliance with various rules and regulations, it should not derail policy from its long-run objective, which is the transition to a less fossil-fuel dependent economy.
abstract_zh: 我们讨论了随着现代水力压裂技术的兴起，美国页岩气繁荣之后天然气价格急剧下跌所带来的环境影响。在论文的第一部分，我们认为，天然气价格的下跌对全球碳排放的影响并不明确，因为存在三种相互抵消的效应：美国电力部门从煤炭向天然气的转换、美国可再生能源相对成本的上升，以及美国煤炭出口的增加。我们的观点是，若缺乏有效的总量上限，页岩气繁荣很可能增加全球排放，而天然气作为清洁能源过渡燃料的时期应当有所限制。在论文的第二部分，我们回顾了近期为美国电力部门制定、并对减少碳排放作出贡献的环境政策，并讨论了新出台的《清洁电力计划》（Clean Power Plan）的复杂经济学问题。尽管廉价天然气已被纳入美国环境政策的考量，并帮助发电企业满足各类规章制度的合规要求，但不应因此偏离其长期目标，即转向对化石燃料依赖程度更低的经济体系。

title: Caution Drivers! Children Present: Traffic, Pollution, and Infant Health
abstract: Since the Clean Air Act Amendments of 1990 (CAAA), atmospheric concentration of local pollutants has fallen drastically.A natural question is whether further reductions will yield additional health benefits. We further this research by addressing two related research questions: ( 1) what is the impact of automobile driving (and especially congestion) on ambient air pollution levels, and ( 2) what is the impact of modern air pollution levels on infant health? Our setting is California (with a focus on the Central Valley and Southern California) in the years 2002-2007.Using an instrumental variables approach that exploits the relationship between traffic, ambient weather conditions, and various pollutants, our findings suggest that ambient pollution levels, specifically particulate matter, still have large impacts on weekly infant mortality rates. Our results also illustrate the importance of weather controls in measuring pollution's impact on infant mortality.
abstract_zh: 自1990年《清洁空气法修正案》（CAAA）颁布以来，当地污染物的大气浓度已大幅下降。一个自然的问题是，进一步减排是否会带来额外的健康收益。我们通过回答两个相关的研究问题来推进这一研究：（1）汽车行驶（尤其是交通拥堵）对环境空气污染水平的影响是什么；（2）现代空气污染水平对婴儿健康的影响是什么？我们的研究场景为加利福尼亚州（重点关注中央谷地和南加州）在2002至2007年间的情况。我们采用工具变量方法，利用交通、环境气象条件与各类污染物之间的关系，研究结果表明，环境污染水平，特别是颗粒物，对每周婴儿死亡率仍有显著影响。我们的结果还说明，在衡量污染对婴儿死亡率的影响时，控制气象因素非常重要。

title: The Simple Economics of Commodity Price Speculation
Who is Exposed to Gas Prices? How Gasoline Prices Affect Automobile Manufacturers and Dealerships
abstract: Many consumers are keenly aware of gasoline prices, and consumer responses to gasoline prices have been well studied. In this paper, by contrast, we investigate how gasoline prices affect the automobile industry: manufacturers and dealerships. We estimate how changes in gasoline prices affect equilibrium prices and sales of both new and used vehicles of different fuel economies. We investigate the implications of these effects for individual auto manufacturers, taking into account differences in manufacturers' vehicle portfolios. We also investigate effects on manufacturers' affiliated dealership networks, including effects implied by the changes in used vehicle market outcomes.
abstract_zh: 许多消费者都敏锐地意识到汽油价格，并且消费者对汽油价格的反应已得到充分研究。与此不同，本文考察的是汽油价格如何影响汽车行业：即汽车制造商和经销商。我们估计了汽油价格的变化如何影响不同燃油经济性的新车和二手车的均衡价格与销量。考虑到各汽车制造商车型组合的差异，我们考察了这些效应对各个汽车制造商的影响。我们还考察了其对制造商所属经销商网络的影响，包括二手车市场结果变化所隐含的效应。

title: Will We Ever Stop Using Fossil Fuels?
abstract: Scientists believe significant climate change is unavoidable without a drastic reduction in the emissions of greenhouse gases from the combustion of fossil fuels. However, few countries have implemented comprehensive policies that price this externality or devote serious resources to developing low carbon energy sources. In many respects, the world is betting that we will greatly reduce the use of fossil fuels because we will run out of inexpensive fossil fuels (i.e., decreases in supply) and/or technological advances will lead to the discovery of less expensive low carbon technologies (i.e., decreases in demand). The historical record indicates that the supply of fossil fuels has consistently increased over time and that their relative price advantage over low carbon energy sources has not declined substantially over time. Without robust efforts to correct the market failures around greenhouse gases, relying on supply and/or demand forces to limit greenhouse gas emissions is relying heavily on hope.
abstract_zh: 科学家认为，若不大幅减少化石燃料燃烧所排放的温室气体，重大气候变化将不可避免。然而，几乎没有哪个国家实施了对这一外部性进行定价的全面政策，或投入大量资源开发低碳能源。在许多方面，世界都在赌我们将大幅减少化石燃料的使用，原因在于我们将耗尽廉价的化石燃料（即供给减少），和/或技术进步将带来更廉价的低碳技术（即需求减少）。历史记录表明，化石燃料的供应一直在持续增长，而其相对于低碳能源的价格优势也并未随时间推移而显著下降。若不着力纠正围绕温室气体的市场失灵，依靠供需力量来限制温室气体排放，在很大程度上只是寄望于侥幸。

title: Working with Data: Two Empiricists' Experience
Ethanol Production and Gasoline Prices: A Spurious Correlation
abstract: Ethanol made from corn comprises 10% of U.S. gasoline, up from 3% in 2003. This dramatic increase was spurred by recent policy initiatives such as the Renewable Fuel Standard and state-level blend mandates and supported by direct subsidies such as the Volumetric Ethanol Excise Tax Credit. Some proponents of ethanol have argued that ethanol production greatly lowers gasoline prices, with one industry group claiming it reduced gasoline prices by 89 cents in 2010 and $1.09 in 2011. The 2010 figure has been cited in numerous speeches by Secretary of Agriculture Thomas Vilsack. We show that these estimates were generated by implausible economic assumptions and spurious statistical correlations. To support this last point, we use the same statistical models and find that ethanol production “decreases” natural gas prices, but “increases” unemployment in both the U.S. and Europe. We even show that ethanol production “increases” the ages of our children. Overall, we see no compelling reason to believe that the effect of ethanol use on gasoline prices has been more than $0.10 per gallon.
abstract_zh: 以玉米为原料生产的乙醇占美国汽油的10%，而2003年这一比例仅为3%。这一急剧增长由《可再生燃料标准》及州级掺混强制要求等近期政策推动，并得到乙醇体积消费税抵免等直接补贴的支持。一些乙醇支持者认为，乙醇生产大幅降低了汽油价格，某行业团体声称其在2010年使汽油价格下降了89美分，2011年下降了1.09美元。2010年的这一数字在农业部长汤姆·维尔萨克（Thomas Vilsack）的多次讲话中被引用。我们证明，这些估计是由不合理的经济假设和虚假的统计相关性得出的。为支持这一最后论点，我们使用相同的统计模型发现，乙醇生产“降低”了天然气价格，却“提高”了美国和欧洲的失业率。我们甚至证明，乙醇生产“增加”了我们子女的年龄。总体而言，我们认为没有令人信服的理由相信乙醇使用对汽油价格的影响超过了每加仑0.10美元。

title: Some Inconvenient Truths About Climate Change Policy: The Distributional Impacts of Transportation Policies
abstract: Climate policy has favored costly measures that implicitly or explicitly subsidize lowcarbon fuels. We simulate four transportation sector policies: cap and trade (CAT), ethanol subsidies, a renewable fuel standard (RFS), and a lowcarbon fuel standard. Our simulations confirm that alternatives to CAT are 2.5 to 4 times more costly but are amenable to adoption due to right-skewed distributions of gains. We analyze voting on the Waxman-Markey (WM) CAT bill. Conditional on a district’s CAT gains, a district’s RFS gains are negatively correlated with the likelihood of voting for WM. Our analysis supports campaign contributions as a partial mechanism.
abstract_zh: 气候政策一直偏好那些代价高昂的措施，这些措施隐含或明确地补贴低碳燃料。我们模拟了四种交通运输部门的政策：总量控制与交易（CAT）、乙醇补贴、可再生燃料标准（RFS）以及低碳燃料标准。我们的模拟证实，CAT的替代方案成本高出2.5至4倍，但由于收益分布呈右偏态，这些方案更容易被采纳。我们分析了对Waxman–Markey（WM）总量控制与交易法案的投票。在控制一个选区的CAT收益的条件下，该选区的RFS收益与投票支持WM的可能性呈负相关。我们的分析支持竞选捐款是其中一项部分作用机制的观点。

title: Tagging and Targeting of Energy Efficiency Subsidies
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings
abstract: A corrective tax or subsidy is “well-targeted” if it primarily affects choices that are more distorted by market failures. Energy efficiency subsidies are designed to correct multiple distortions: externalities, credit constraints, “landlord-tenant” information asymmetries, imperfect information, and inattention. We show that three important energy efficiency subsidies are primarily taken up by consumers who are wealthier, own their own homes, and are more informed about and attentive to energy costs. This suggests that these subsidies are poorly targeted at the market failures they were designed to address. However, we show that “tagging” can lead to large efficiency gains.
abstract_zh: 若一项矫正性税收或补贴主要影响那些受市场失灵扭曲更为严重的选择，则称其为“精准定向”。能源效率补贴旨在纠正多重扭曲：外部性、信贷约束、“房东—租客”信息不对称、信息不完全以及注意力不足。我们表明，三项重要的能源效率补贴主要被那些更富裕、拥有自有住房、并且对能源成本更为了解和关注的消费者所利用。这表明，这些补贴在针对其原本旨在解决的市场失灵方面定向不佳。然而，我们表明，“标签化”（tagging）可以带来可观的效率收益。

title: Unintended Consequences of Transportation Carbon Policies: Land-Use, Emission, and Innovation
An Economic Perspective on the EPA's Clean Power Plan
Celebrity Endorsements, Firm Value and Reputation Risk: Evidence from the Tiger Woods Scandal

The Origins of US Transportation Policy: Was There Ever Support for Gasoline Taxes?
Are Consumers Myopic? Evidence from New and Used Car Purchases

abstract: The price of oil increased more than 650 percent from 1972 to 1980. I review the policy discussion of the time through the lens of the printed press. I pay particular attention to whether gasoline taxes were “on the table” and how consumers viewed the different policies. Meaningful changes in gasoline taxes were on the table, but polling evidence at the time suggests that consumers preferred price controls, rationing and vehicle taxes. Given the saliency of rationing and vehicle taxes, it seems difficult to argue that these alternative polices were adopted because they hide their true costs.
abstract_zh: 1972年至1980年间，油价上涨了650%以上。本文从当时的报刊视角回顾了这一时期的政策讨论。我特别关注汽油税是否曾被“摆上台面”，以及消费者如何看待各种政策。汽油税的实质性调整确实曾被提上议程，但当时的民意调查显示，消费者更偏好价格管制、配给制和车辆税。鉴于配给制和车辆税受到的关注程度，很难论证这些替代政策之所以被采纳，是因为它们掩盖了真实成本。

Sacred Cars? Cost-Effective Regulation of Stationary and Non-stationary Pollution Sources

title: Strategic Incompatibility in ATMs
Tacit Collusion in the Presence of Cyclical Demand and Endogenous Capacity Levels

Greenhouse Gas Reductions under Low Carbon Fuel Standards?
abstract: A low carbon fuel standard (LCFS) seeks to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by limiting a fuel producer's carbon emissions per unit of output. California has launched an LCFS for transportation fuels; others have called for a national LCFS.We show that this policy decreases production of high-carbon fuels but increases production of low-carbon fuels. The net effect of this may be an increase in carbon emissions. The LCFS cannot be first best, and the best LCFS may reduce social welfare. We simulate the outcomes of a national LCFS, focusing on gasoline and ethanol as the high-and low-carbon fuels. For a broad range of parameters, we find that the LCFS is unlikely to increase CO2 emissions. However, the surplus losses from the LCFS are likely to be quite large ($80 to $760 billion annually for a national LCFS reducing carbon intensities by 10 percent), energy prices are likely to increase, and the average carbon cost ($307 to $2,272 per ton of CO2 for the same LCFS) can be much larger than damage estimates. We describe an efficient policy that achieves the same emissions reduction at a much lower surplus cost ($16 to $290 billion) and much lower average carbon cost ($60 to $868 per ton of CO2).
abstract_zh: 低碳燃料标准（LCFS）旨在通过限制燃料生产者每单位产出的碳排放量来减少温室气体排放。加利福尼亚州已为交通燃料推行了LCFS；其他人则呼吁实施全国性的LCFS。我们证明，该政策会减少高碳燃料的生产，但会增加低碳燃料的生产。其净效应可能是碳排放的增加。LCFS不可能达到第一最优，最优的LCFS甚至可能降低社会福利。我们模拟了全国性LCFS的结果，重点关注汽油和乙醇分别作为高碳燃料和低碳燃料的情形。在广泛的参数范围内，我们发现LCFS不太可能增加CO2排放。然而，LCFS带来的剩余损失可能相当大（对于将碳强度降低10%的全国性LCFS，每年为800亿至7600亿美元），能源价格可能上涨，且平均碳成本（同一LCFS下每吨CO2为307至2272美元）可能远高于损害估计值。我们描述了一种有效政策，它能以低得多的剩余成本（160亿至2900亿美元）和低得多的平均碳成本（每吨CO2 60至868美元）实现相同的减排效果。

title: How Does Incompatibility Affect Prices?: Evidence from ATMs
Re-Assessing the Quality Adjustment to Computer Prices: Do U.S. Procedures Overstate the Gains?
Diagnosing Unilateral Market Power in Electricity Reserves Market
abstract: We use information released during the investigation of the California electricity crisis of 2000 and 2001 by theFederal Energy Regulatory Commission to diagnose allocative inefficiencies in the state’s wholesale reserve markets. Material that has been largely neglected allows us to replicate market outcomes with a high degree of precision for the second and third quarters of 2000. Building on the work ofWolak (2000), we calculate a lower bound for the sellers’ price-cost margins using the inverse elasticities of their residual demand curves. The downward bias in our estimates stem from the fact that we do not account for the hierarchical substitutability of the reserve types. The margins averaged at least 20% for the two highest quality types of reserves, regulation and spinning, generating millions of dollars in transfers to a handful of sellers. We attribute the deviations from marginal cost pricing to the markets’ high concentration and a principal–agent relationship that emerged from their design.
abstract_zh: 我们利用联邦能源管理委员会在调查2000年至2001年加州电力危机期间公布的信息，诊断该州批发备用容量市场中的配置低效问题。这些此前大多被忽视的材料使我们能够高精度地复现2000年第二和第三季度的市场结果。在Wolak（2000）工作的基础上，我们利用卖方剩余需求曲线的逆弹性，计算了卖方价格-成本加成的下界。我们估计结果的向下偏差源于未考虑备用类型之间的层级替代性。对于两类质量最高的备用容量（调节备用和旋转备用），加成平均至少为20%，为少数卖方带来了数百万美元的转移支付。我们将偏离边际成本定价的现象归因于市场的高度集中，以及其设计中产生的委托-代理关系。

title: Evidence of a Shift in the Short-Run Price Elasticity of Gasoline
abstract: Understanding the sensitivity of gasoline demand to changes in prices and income has important implications for policies related to climate change, optimal taxation and national security. The short-run price and income elasticities of gasoline demand in the United States during the 1970s and 1980s have been studied extensively. However, transportation analysts have hypothesized that behavioral and structural factors over the past several decades have changed the responsiveness of U.S. consumers to changes in gasoline prices. We compare the price and income elasticities of gasoline demand in two periods of similarly high prices from 1975 to 1980 and 2001 to 2006. The short-run price elasticities differ considerably: and range from -0.034 to -0.077 during 2001 to 2006, versus -0.21 to -0.34 for 1975 to 1980. The estimated short-run income elasticities range from 0.21 to 0.75 and when estimated with the same models are not significantly different between the two periods.
abstract_zh: 理解汽油需求对价格和收入变化的敏感性，对气候变化、最优税收和国家安全相关政策具有重要意义。1970年代和1980年代美国汽油需求的短期价格和收入弹性已被广泛研究。然而，交通分析人士推测，过去几十年间的行为和结构性因素改变了美国消费者对汽油价格变化的反应程度。我们比较了1975年至1980年和2001年至2006年两个油价同样高企时期的汽油需求价格和收入弹性。两个时期的短期价格弹性差异显著：2001年至2006年间的范围为-0.034至-0.077，而1975年至1980年间为-0.21至-0.34。估计的短期收入弹性范围为0.21至0.75，且在使用相同模型估计时，两个时期之间并无显著差异。

title: Incompatibility, Product Attributes and Consumer Welfare: Evidence from ATMs

title: Inefficiencies and Market Power in Financial Arbitrage: A Study of California's Electricity Markets
abstract: For two years prior to the collapse of California's restructured electricity market, power traded in both a forward and a spot market for delivery at the same times and locations. Nonetheless, prices in the two markets often differed in significant and predictable ways. This apparent inefficiency persisted, we argue, because most firms believed that trading on inter‐market price differences would yield regulatory penalties. For the few firms that did make such trades, it was not profit‐maximizing to eliminate the price differences entirely. Skyrocketing prices in 2000 changed the major buyers' (utilities') incentives and exacerbated the price differentials between the markets.
abstract_zh: 在加州重组后的电力市场崩溃之前的两年里，同一时间、同一地点交付的电力同时在远期市场和现货市场进行交易。然而，两个市场的价格经常以显著且可预测的方式存在差异。我们认为，这种明显的低效率之所以持续存在，是因为大多数企业认为，利用市场间价格差异进行交易会招致监管处罚。对于少数确实进行此类交易的企业而言，彻底消除价格差异并不符合利润最大化。2000年价格飙升改变了主要买方（即公用事业公司）的激励，并加剧了两个市场之间的价格差异。

title: Biases in Static Oligopoly Models? Evidence from the California Electricity Market
abstract: Estimating market power is often complicated by the lack of reliable measures of marginal cost. Instead, policy-makers often rely on other summary statistics of the market, thought to be correlated with price cost margins---such as concentration ratios or the HHI.In many industries, these summary statistics may be only weakly correlated with deviations from perfectly competitive pricing. Beginning with Gollop and Roberts (1979), a number of empirical studies have allowed the data to identify industry competition and marginal cost levels by estimating the firms' first order condition within a conjectural variations framework. Despite the prevalence of such "New Empirical Industrial Organization" (NEIO) studies, Corts (1999) illustrates the estimated mark-up levels may be biased, since the estimated conjectural variations model forces the supply relationship to be a ray through the marginal cost intercept, whereas this need not be true in dynamic games. In this paper, we use direct measures of marginal cost for the California electricity market to measure the extent to which estimated mark-ups and marginal costs are biased. Our results suggest that the NEIO technique poorly estimates the level of mark-ups and the sensitivity of marginal cost to cost shifters.
abstract_zh: 估计市场势力常常因缺乏可靠的边际成本衡量指标而变得复杂。因此，政策制定者通常依赖其他市场汇总统计量，例如集中度比率或赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI），它们被认为与价格-成本加成相关。在许多行业中，这些汇总统计量与偏离完全竞争定价的程度可能只是弱相关。自Gollop和Roberts（1979）开始，许多实证研究通过在猜测变分框架下估计厂商的一阶条件，使数据能够识别行业竞争程度和边际成本水平。尽管这类“新经验产业组织”（NEIO）研究十分普遍，Corts（1999）指出，估计的加成水平可能存在偏差，因为所估计的猜测变分模型迫使供给关系成为经过边际成本截距的射线，而在动态博弈中这未必成立。本文利用加州电力市场边际成本的直接衡量指标，来衡量估计的加成和边际成本存在偏差的程度。我们的结果表明，NEIO方法对加成水平以及边际成本对成本冲击变量的敏感性估计得很差。

title: The Adoption of State Electricity Regulation: The Role of Interest Groups
abstract: This paper examines the adoption of state electricity regulation around the beginning of the 20th century. I model this decision as a hazard rate to determine what influenced the adoption of state regulation. I find that adoption is positively correlated with capacity shortages, greater wealth and lower residential electricity penetration rates. These results suggest that state regulation responded to regulatory inefficiencies and residential consumer interests. In addition, adoption rates were higher in states that had a strong industrial and coal mining presence. These results are consistent with the interest group and contracting theories of regulation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了20世纪初各州电力监管的采纳情况。我将这一决策建模为风险率（hazard rate），以确定哪些因素影响了州监管的采纳。我发现，采纳与容量短缺、较高的财富水平以及较低的居民用电普及率呈正相关。这些结果表明，州监管回应了监管低效和居民消费者的利益。此外，在工业和煤矿业较为发达的州，采纳率更高。这些结果与监管的利益集团理论和契约理论相一致。

title: Financial Models of Deregulated Electricity Prices: An Application to the California Market
Regulatory Restructuring and Incumbent Price Dynamics: The Case of Local Telephone Markets
Market Structure and the Pricing of Electricity and Natural Gas
abstract: US Electricity and natural gas markets have traditionally been serviced by one of two market structures. In some markets, electricity and natural gas are sold by a regulated dual‐product monopolist, while in other markets, electricity and natural gas are sold by separate regulated single‐product monopolies. I analyze whether electricity and natural gas prices depend on the market structure and compare these results to the predictions of a number of theories. The results are most consistent with the political economy theories suggesting that regulators respond to interest group activity.
abstract_zh: 美国的电力和天然气市场历来由两种市场结构之一提供服务。在某些市场中，电力和天然气由同一家受监管的双产品垄断者供应；而在另一些市场中，电力和天然气分别由受监管的单产品垄断者供应。本文分析了电力和天然气价格是否取决于市场结构，并将这些结果与若干理论的预测进行比较。结果与政治经济学理论最为一致，即监管者会对利益集团的活动作出回应。

title: Price Ceilings as Focal Points for Tacit Collusion: Evidence from the Credit Card Market
Alternative Regulatory Methods and Firm Efficiency: Stochastic Frontier Evidence from the US Electricity Industry
abstract: The use of incentive regulation and other alternative regulatory programs in U.S. electricity markets has grown during the past two decades. Within a stochastic frontier framework, I investigate the effect of individual programs on the technical efficiency of a large set of coal and natural gas generation units. I find that those programs tied directly to generator performance and those that modify traditional fuel cost pass-through programs, to provide a greater incentive to reduce fuel costs, are associated with greater efficiency levels. Other programs have no statistical association with efficiency levels.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，激励性监管及其他替代性监管计划在美国电力市场中的应用不断增加。本文在随机前沿框架下，考察了各项具体计划对大量煤电机组和天然气发电机组技术效率的影响。研究发现，那些与发电机组绩效直接挂钩的计划，以及那些修改传统燃料成本传导机制、从而更有力地激励降低燃料成本的计划，与更高的效率水平相关。其他计划与效率水平之间不存在统计上的显著关联。

title: Market Power in Electricity Markets: Beyond Concentration Measures
abstract: The wave of electricity market restructuring both within the United States and abroad has brought the issue of horizontal market power to the forefront of energy policy. Traditionally, estimation and prediction of market power has relied heavily on concentration measures. In this paper, we discuss the weaknesses of concentration measures as a viable measure of market power in the electricity industry, and we propose an alternative method based oil market simulations that take advantage of existing plant level data. We discuss results from previous studies the authors have performed, and present new results that allow for the detection of threshold demand levels where market power is likely to be a problem. In addition, we analyze the impact of that recent divestitures in the California electricity market will have on estimated market power. We close with a discussion of the policy implications of the results.
abstract_zh: 电力市场重组的浪潮在美国境内外都使水平市场势力问题成为能源政策的焦点。传统上，市场势力的估计和预测在很大程度上依赖于集中度指标。本文讨论了集中度指标作为衡量电力行业市场势力可行指标的弱点，并提出了一种基于市场模拟的替代方法，该方法利用了现有的电厂层面数据。我们讨论了作者此前开展的研究结果，并给出新的结果，以识别可能存在市场势力问题的需求阈值水平。此外，我们分析了加州电力市场近期的资产剥离将对估计的市场势力产生的影响。最后，我们讨论了这些结果的政策含义。

title: Generational Trends in Vehicle Ownership and Use: Are Millennials Any Different?
venue: The Energy Journal (listed as permanent working paper)
abstract: Anecdotes that Millennials fundamentally differ from prior generations are numerous in the popular press. One claim is that Millennials, happy to rely on public transit or ride-hailing, are less likely to own vehicles and travel less in personal vehicles than previous generations. However, in this discussion it is unclear whether these perceived differences are driven by changes in preferences or the impact of forces beyond the control of Millennials, such as the Great Recession. We empirically test whether Millennials' vehicle ownership and use preferences differ from those of previous generations using data from the US National Household Travel Survey, Census, and American Community Survey. We estimate both regression and nearest-neighbor matching models to control for the confounding effect of demographic and macroeconomic variables. We find little difference in preferences for vehicle ownership between Millennials and prior generations once we control for confounding variables. In contrast to the anecdotes, we find higher usage in terms of vehicle miles traveled (VMT) compared to Baby Boomers. Next we test whether Millennials are altering endogenous life choices that may, themselves, affect vehicles ownership and use. We find that Millennials are more likely to live in urban settings and less likely to marry by age 35, but tend to have larger families, controlling for age. On net, these other choices have a small effect on vehicle ownership, reducing the number of vehicles per household by less than one percent.
abstract_zh: 关于千禧一代与前几代人存在根本差异的说法在大众媒体中屡见不鲜。其中一种观点认为，千禧一代乐于依赖公共交通或网约车，因此拥有车辆的可能性较低，个人驾车出行也比前几代人少。然而，在这些讨论中，尚不清楚这些被感知到的差异是由偏好变化驱动，还是由大衰退等超出千禧一代控制范围的力量所致。我们利用美国全国家庭出行调查、人口普查和美国社区调查的数据，实证检验了千禧一代在车辆拥有和使用偏好上是否不同于前几代人。我们同时估计了回归模型和最近邻匹配模型，以控制人口统计和宏观经济变量的混杂效应。在控制了混杂变量之后，我们发现千禧一代与前几代人在车辆拥有偏好上差异甚微。与上述说法相反，以车辆行驶里程（VMT）衡量，我们发现千禧一代的使用量高于婴儿潮一代。接下来，我们检验千禧一代是否正在改变可能反过来影响车辆拥有和使用的内生生活选择。我们发现，控制年龄后，千禧一代更可能居住在城市环境中，35岁前结婚的可能性较低，但家庭规模往往更大。综合来看，这些其他选择对车辆拥有的影响较小，使每户车辆数减少不到1%。

title: Charging Uncertainty: Real-Time Charging Data and Electric Vehicle Adoption
abstract: Charging infrastructure is critical to electric vehicle (EV) adoption, but for chargers to be most useful, EV drivers need to know in real time where they are and whether they are working and available. We investigate the availability of real-time data from DC fast chargers on six major US Interstates and model the impacts of expanding access to real-time data to all DC fast chargers near highways. On average, between March and August 2024, 32.9% of DC fast charging stations adjacent to those six Interstates provided their real-time status on PlugShare, a major chargefinding app, with gaps of up to 1,308 miles without real-time data. Further, we survey potential car buyers and EV owners and find low credibility of currently-available real-time data. We incorporate this data into a two-sided model of consumer vehicle choice and charging station build-out adapted from Cole et al. (2023).If universal real-time data is accompanied by improved charger uptime and driver confidence in the accuracy of the real-time data, we predict that the EV share of new vehicle sales would grow by 8.0 percentage points in 2030, expanding the EV fleet by 13.2%, and reducing 2030 carbon emissions by 22.5 mmt, versus baseline projections for 2030.
abstract_zh: 充电基础设施对电动汽车（EV）的普及至关重要，但要让充电桩发挥最大作用，电动汽车驾驶者需要实时了解充电桩的位置，以及其是否正常运行和可用。我们调查了美国六条主要州际公路上直流快速充电桩实时数据的可获得性，并模拟了将实时数据覆盖扩展到公路附近所有直流快速充电桩的影响。2024年3月至8月期间，平均而言，上述六条州际公路旁的直流快速充电站中有32.9%通过PlugShare（一款主要的充电桩查找应用）提供了实时状态，且存在长达1308英里的无实时数据路段。此外，我们对潜在购车者和电动汽车车主进行了调查，发现目前可获得的实时数据可信度较低。我们将这些数据纳入消费者车辆选择与充电站建设的双边模型，该模型借鉴并改编自Cole等人（2023）的研究。如果普遍的实时数据伴随着充电桩正常运行时间的改善以及驾驶者对实时数据准确性信心的提升，我们预测到2030年，电动汽车在新车销量中的份额将增加8.0个百分点，电动汽车保有量将扩大13.2%，并且与2030年的基准预测相比，2030年的碳排放将减少2250万公吨（22.5 mmt）。

abstract: Mangroves provide vital ecosystem services like storm surge protection and carbon sequestration, but their coverage is rapidly declining. This study evaluates an environmental education program in the Dominican Republic, targeting children’s attitudes, knowledge, behaviors, and willingness to pay for conservation. The program boosted attitudes, especially in girls, with modest, non-significant behavioral changes. There were also positive spillover effects on peers and parents, with non-treated peers in clubs showing increased mangrove preference and positive attitude shifts in parents.
abstract_zh: 红树林提供风暴潮防护和碳汇等重要生态系统服务，但其覆盖面积正在迅速减少。本研究评估了多米尼加共和国的一项环境教育项目，该项目旨在改变儿童的态度、知识、行为以及对保护的支付意愿。该项目提升了儿童的态度，尤其是女孩的态度，行为方面则有一定变化但不显著。项目还对同伴和家长产生了正向溢出效应：俱乐部中未接受干预的同伴表现出对红树林偏好的增加，家长的态度也出现了正向转变。
